svg.title: Currently on repeat
svg.desc: A rotating selection of seven album covers: Victim by Abbie Falls; Black Lotus by Crown Magnetar; OBSOLETE. DELETE. REPEAT. by The Browning; Boiled in a Pot by Frog Mallet; Carrion Ladder by Archspire; Servant to Instinct by Netherwalker; Rifts to Abhorrence by Analepsy.
